name: @papercusp/decision-model
description: Provider-agnostic client for typed decision models (choice / score / yes-no questions answered with probabilities, no text output). Ships a TypeSafe Jev adapter pinned to a versioned model id, a single-deadline client with 429/529 backoff, per-call credential resolution and a fire-and-forget call observer. Every failure is a typed inconclusive{reason} — never an empty verdict. Zero domain coupling behind a configure*() seam.
